paper: AutoCkt: Deep Reinforcement Learning of Analog Circuit Designs
method: Manually transcribed the eight MOS devices, bias source, and compensation capacitor after rendering and inspecting Figure 6. The load capacitor is supplied by the testbench.
known_from_figure: NMOS differential pair with PMOS current-mirror load
NMOS tail current mirror and diode-connected reference
PMOS second-stage device with NMOS current-source load
Miller capacitor between stage-one output and final output
engineering_choices: SKY130 nfet_01v8 and pfet_01v8 replace the paper's 45 nm predictive devices.
Supply is 1.8 V, common mode 0.9 V, load 10 pF and temperature 27 C.
All device lengths are 1 um; widths and compensation value are project choices.
NMOS bodies connect to ground, PMOS bodies to supply; input labels are assigned for positive forward gain.
limitations: No recovery of original transistor sizes or reported performance.
No layout, mismatch, process-corner, noise, CMRR or PSRR validation yet.

reference_design.method: Manual sizing with the fixed pilot tests; no RL training.
